newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster says U.S. clears Barefoot buy.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster says U.S. clears Barefoot buy.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Monday its proposed acquisition of Barefoot Inc has cleared federal regulatory requirements under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act.

The company said the government did not request any further antitrust information about the $230-million deal, which gives Barefoot stockholders their choice of $16 a share in cash or an equivalent amount of ServiceMaster shares. The transaction still requires approval of holders of at least 75 percent of Barefoot's 14.5 million common shares, ServiceMaster said.
ServiceMaster provides lawn care, residential maid and security services. Its stock closed down 1/4 Monday at 25-3/8.
